additionalProperty.name: Screen
additionalProperty.value: None. There is no screen on the toy and none in the play.

additionalProperty.name: Languages
additionalProperty.value: 8 at launch (English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Spanish, and French), up to 10. Switches mid-sentence.

additionalProperty.name: Modes
additionalProperty.value: Three: AI mode for open conversation, Story mode for stories and lessons, Bluetooth mode as a speaker.

additionalProperty.name: Microphone
additionalProperty.value: Wakes to a word. Off the rest of the time, not muted.

additionalProperty.name: Internet access
additionalProperty.value: None. Answers come from a closed library. Kheelu cannot browse or search.

additionalProperty.name: Works offline
additionalProperty.value: Story-mode stories and lessons, and Bluetooth music with a paired phone. AI mode needs home WiFi.

additionalProperty.name: Parent app
additionalProperty.value: Every conversation word for word, deletable in one tap, plus topic controls and quiet hours.

additionalProperty.name: Where the voice data goes
additionalProperty.value: Stays in your region. Never sold, never used to advertise to your child.

mainEntity.name: Is Kheelu safe for my child?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kheelu wakes to a word, thinks on the device first, and answers from a closed library. There is a safety check on every reply, and you can read or delete anything. The five checks worth applying to any AI toy, including this one, are set out in our guide to choosing one.

Only for open conversation: AI mode runs on your home WiFi. Story-mode stories and lessons work offline, and Bluetooth music needs only a paired phone. New content and updates download when you choose.
English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Spanish, and French, with up to ten at launch. Kheelu switches mid-sentence, in the languages you speak at home.
Ages 3+. Kheelu meets your child where they are, and the family that follows brings learning toys for 5 and 6 year olds onward, growing right alongside.

mainEntity.name: What are the best learning toys for 3-year-olds?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a toy that answers back. At 3, children learn through back-and-forth conversation: questions, stories they can interrupt, words that build on yesterday's words. Kheelu is an AI educational toy built around exactly that loop, and it grows with your child from 3 up.
Yes. The full log stays private to you, in the parent app.
No. Never sold, never used to sell your child anything. That is the whole point.

mainEntity.name: Is Kheelu a good birthday gift?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a unique birthday gift in one specific way: it keeps changing. Kheelu learns your child's words and grows with them, so the toy at 5 is not the toy they unwrapped at 3. Reserving now holds the ₹4,999 price.
